author: Ankit
problem: Read an amount X (0 to 1000). A purse holds one or more 100-yen coins and nothing else; print Yes if its total could be exactly X yen, otherwise No.
bug_description: Only checks that X is at least 100, so amounts that aren't a multiple of 100 (like 250) get Yes.

comments.accurate: Checks whether X yen can be made from one or more 100-yen coins
comments.wrong_behavior: Any amount from 100 yen up is possible, since the purse holds at least one 100-yen coin
comments.wrong_location: Coin condition verified; check that the input is read as an integer, not a string
